raw_text: Next.js TS App Router `src`; UI `src/components`; hooks `src/hooks`; utils `src/lib`; routes `src/app`; API `src/app/api/*`; assets `public/`; scripts `scripts/`; Vite `vite-base-template/`. Commands: `npm run dev`; `npm run build`; `npm run start`; `npm run lint`; `cd vite-base-template && npm run dev`; `npm --prefix vite-base-template run build`. Strict, `noEmit: true`, `@/*`→`src/*`; Tailwind v4. No test runner; prefer Vitest/Jest + React Testing Library. PRs must include summary/rationale, test steps/screenshots, linked issues/checklist. Use `.env.local`; do not commit secrets. `NEXT_PUBLIC_*` client-exposed. Rotate leaked credentials promptly; prefer per-env keys.
